name: Subhra Mazumdar
description: Subhra Mazumdar is an Assistant Professor in the Department of CSE, Indian Institute of Technology Indore. Before that, she was a post-doctoral researcher in the Security and Privacy (S&P) Research Unit at Vienna University of Technology, Austria, where she worked on rational attacks on Layer 2 protocols in Blockchain. She did both Ph.D. and M.tech in Computer Science from Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata, in 2022 and 2018, respectively.
